To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a distributed systems-driven deep learning training system is worth pursuing, (2) asynchronous SGD is an efficient and effective algorithm, (3) a whole system co-designed approach to training large deep neural networks is necessary to achieve high performance, scalability, and task accuracy.
Adam achieves world-class efficiency, scalability and accuracy in training deep neural networks.

(1) we built a system called Adam that trains deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs) with high efficiency, scalability and task accuracy; (2) Adam is comprised of commodity server nodes, each with 8 GPU cards and 4 CPUs, and a central master node; (3) we use asynchronous training and a novel distributed synchronous SGD algorithm to improve efficiency and scalability;
